notes.title: The Lost Legends of Redwall™: Feasts & Friends Available Now!
notes.content:
[b][i]The Lost Legends of Redwall™: Feasts & Friends[/i], released today![/b] 

[b]Nothing says [i]Redwall[/i] quite like a delicious feast, and in [i]Feasts & Friends[/i], you'll slice, dice, and cook your way to the annual Lilygrove Cook-Off.[/b] Cook your way through culinary challenges as chef Rootsworth, and make friends with other woodlanders along the way.

We hope that the game brings joy to the long-time fans of the series as well as inviting in a wave of brand-new Redwall enthusiasts. [b]We're so excited for you to try it![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789972/98b8544bbe37b4d275bdbc6e4a9d06fad6090527.png[/img]
